meta.title: DeepSeek Search Interface
meta.description: A frontend-only web search UI for the DeepSeek Search API. Your API key never leaves this browser.

home.description: Search the live web with relevance scores and authority ratings. Your API key stays in this browser.
home.syntaxHint: Type site: lang: after: to get completions, then Tab to insert. Press / to focus the search box.
home.apiKeyAlertTitle: Add your DeepSeek API key first
home.apiKeyAlertDescription: Searches go straight from the browser to api.deepseek.com. The key never leaves this device.

search.placeholder: Type keywords, or use site: lang: after: syntax
search.completionHint: ↑↓ to choose · Tab to insert · Esc to close
search.lengthOver: {count} / 128 characters — over the limit, cannot submit
search.resetTooltip: Reset query options (count, sort, switches, localization IP)

advanced.title: Query builder
advanced.applyHint: Replaces the search box content and searches immediately.
advanced.keywordsPlaceholder: Space-separated; results must contain all of them
advanced.siteHelp: Several sites are joined with OR
advanced.oriQuestionHelp: Up to 128 characters; helps the server understand your intent
advanced.oriQuestionPlaceholder: e.g. how do I deploy vLLM in production?
advanced.localizationHelp: Bias results toward this region; leave empty to skip

results.emptyFiltered: Nothing matches the current filters. Try turning off local filtering.
results.emptySearch: Try different wording, or drop qualifiers like site: / after:.
results.footer: Results come from the DeepSeek Search API. This page only renders them — it does not proxy or store your requests.

result.contentLabel: Page content (raw Markdown, showing up to 20,000 characters)
result.scoreTooltip: Combined relevance score 0–3; 1.5 and above is high quality
result.summary: Long summary ({count} characters; good for handing to a model)
result.copyFailedDescription: The browser denied clipboard access. Select the text and copy it manually.

syntax.site: Limit results to these sites; combine several with OR
syntax.lang: Limit the language; separate several with commas
syntax.after: Only pages published after this date
syntax.before: Only pages published before this date

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Everything here is stored on this device only.
settings.connectionDescription: Searches go from your browser straight to this address; credentials never pass through a third party.
settings.apiKeyHelp: Create one under API Keys on platform.deepseek.com; it looks like sk-…
settings.savedDescription: The API key is only written to localStorage on this device.
settings.keyCleared: Removed the API key from this device
settings.baseUrlHelp: Defaults to the official endpoint. Replace it if your key has to go through a self-hosted gateway.
settings.defaultsDescription: These are the same options as the toolbar on the results page: changing them here changes the defaults, while the toolbar makes one-off adjustments.
settings.countHelp: 1–50; affects only how many results come back, not billing
settings.sortHelp: Sorted locally over the returned results at no extra cost; “Relevance” keeps the API order
settings.localizationHelp: Bias results toward this region; leave empty to skip
settings.needContentDescription: Returns the full page in content, which you can then read inline.
settings.interfaceDescription: These take effect immediately; there is nothing to save.
settings.layoutHelp: Multi-column shows two columns at 1024px and wider.
settings.languageHelp: Applies immediately and is remembered on this device.
settings.keepHistoryDescription: Turning this off stops recording and clears existing history.
settings.aboutIntro: DeepSeek Search Interface is a frontend-only UI built with Vue 3, Nuxt 4 and Nuxt UI.
settings.licenseText: Released under the MIT license: free to use, modify and redistribute, including commercially; redistributions must keep the original copyright notice and the full license text.
settings.billingText: Search costs CNY 5 per 1,000 successful requests; only requests that return results are billed. “Verify key” calls /models, which is not billed as a search. Prices may change — see the official pricing page for the authoritative numbers.
settings.rateText: 5 QPS per account. When you hit the limit the page asks you to retry shortly; see the official guide for details.
settings.dataText: This page has no backend of its own. Apart from sending your API key and query to the API endpoint you configured (the official DeepSeek endpoint by default), nothing is uploaded to or stored on any other server. Settings and search history live in localStorage on this device and disappear when you clear browser data.
settings.dutyText: You are responsible for safeguarding your API key, your account quota and charges, and how you use the results. Follow DeepSeek's terms of service and judge for yourself whether results fit your scenario — this UI only displays them and does not vouch for their accuracy.
settings.storageText: The key is stored in plain text in localStorage and readable by any script running on this device. On a shared computer, click “Remove key” when you are done.

verify.valid: Key is valid — you can search now.
verify.invalidKey: The API key is invalid or was deleted.
verify.insufficient: The account balance is too low; top up and retry.
verify.httpError: The API returned HTTP {status}; the key status is unknown.
verify.httpErrorWithMessage: The API returned HTTP {status}: {message}. The key status is unknown.
verify.network: The request could not be sent (offline, proxy or CORS). You can try searching anyway.
verify.failed: The verification request failed. Try again later.

validation.oriQuestionTooLong: The original question is limited to 128 characters.
validation.localization: The localization IP is not a valid address, e.g. 203.0.113.10 or 2001:db8::1.

contract.missingResults: The response has no results field — it may not come from the Search API.
contract.resultsNotArray: The results field is not an array — it may not come from the Search API.
contract.itemsMissingUrl: Items in results have no url field; the API may use different field names than the docs.
contract.title: Unexpected response format
contract.hint: Check that the API endpoint points to a DeepSeek Search–compatible service, or make your gateway forward the results field unchanged.

400.title: Invalid request
400.hint: Check that the query is 1–128 characters and the syntax follows the docs.

401.title: Invalid API key
401.hint: Enter the key again in settings and confirm it belongs to this account and has not been deleted.

402.title: Insufficient balance
402.hint: Search bills CNY 5 per 1,000 successful requests. Top up and retry.

403.title: Request rejected
403.hint: The API's safety policy blocked this request. Try a different query.

404.title: No content available
404.hint: The target resource is unavailable. Adjust the query and retry.

408.title: Request timed out
408.hint: Wait a few seconds and retry.

413.title: Payload too large
413.hint: Trim the query and options, then retry.

429.title: Too many requests
429.hint: Search allows 5 QPS per account. Wait a moment and search again.

500.title: Internal server error
500.hint: Retry after a moment; repeated failures point to a server-side problem.

errors.statusDetailMissing: The API did not include a detailed explanation.
errors.unexpectedStatusDetail: The API returned an unexpected status code.
errors.unknownStatusHint: Retry shortly; if it keeps failing, change the API endpoint in settings.
errors.networkHint: Check your connection. If you use a proxy or custom endpoint, it must allow browser cross-origin requests (CORS).
errors.invalidInputTitle: Options do not meet the API requirements
errors.missingKeyDetail: The Search API uses Bearer auth, so it needs your own DeepSeek API key.
errors.missingKeyHint: Add the key and search right away — it stays in this browser.
